A1.justification: Both PDFs contain the same complete, readable 26-page WIMLE paper, including Appendices A-F. Text and rendered-page comparisons establish identical substantive content; the only visible difference is the first-page arXiv version/date stamp.

before.justification: v1 reports original WIMLE continuous-control experiments, baseline comparisons, ablations, and timing results in Section 4 and Appendices C, E, and F.

after.justification: v2 retains the same original WIMLE experiments, ablations, and timing results in the main text and appendices.

M1.justification: The IMLE world models, ensemble-based uncertainty estimation, confidence-weighted learning, architecture, and rollout procedures are identical in Section 3 and Algorithms 1-3.

E1.justification: Both retain the same 16 DMC, 10 MyoSuite, and 14 HumanoidBench tasks, plus the supplementary MuJoCo Humanoid comparison in Figure 13. No evaluated task or scenario is added or removed.

E2.justification: Comparator membership is identical within corresponding experiments, including the benchmark comparisons in Tables 2-5 and the InfoProp comparisons in Figure 13 and Table 10.

E3.justification: The benchmark training budgets, evaluation metrics, score normalization, model configurations, and task-specific rollout settings are unchanged in Section 4.1 and Appendices D-F.

E4.justification: Both contain identical uncertainty-weighting and IMLE-versus-Gaussian ablations, rollout-length sensitivity tests, weight-evolution analysis, imagined-only training comparison, and wall-clock analyses.

E5.justification: The default 10 random seeds, experiment-specific seed counts, IQM reporting, and 95% confidence intervals using stratified bootstrap remain unchanged in Section 4.1 and the figure captions.

E6.justification: All reported values, curves, rankings, and qualitative findings are identical, including appendix results. For example, Table 2 reports WIMLE's DMC IQM at 1M steps as 0.871 in both versions.

T1.justification: The mathematical definitions, assumptions, Bellman-target preservation lemma, inverse-variance weighting analysis, and complete proofs in Appendix B are identical.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction, and conclusion retain the same novelty and performance claims concerning IMLE world models, uncertainty-weighted synthetic learning, and sample-efficient continuous control.

C2.justification: The explanations of multimodality, uncertainty calibration, and rollout stability are unchanged. Section 6 retains the same limitations concerning model usage, proprioceptive observations, and task-dependent rollout horizons.

D1.justification: Implementation and reproducibility information is identical, including Appendix A algorithms, Table 1 hyperparameters, Tables 6-9 task and normalization settings, and Figure 2 hardware information.

R1.justification: Section 5, the reference list, and the positioning relative to earlier world models, uncertainty methods, and IMLE research are unchanged.

P1.justification: Only the first-page marginal stamp changes from arXiv v1 dated 15 February 2026 to v2 dated 3 April 2026. All paper wording, headings, and main-text and appendix organization remain identical.

P2.justification: Figures 1-14, Tables 1-10, captions, axes, legends, and placement are identical. Rendered pages 2-26 match exactly; page 1 differs only in the administrative stamp text.

improvement.justification: v2 preserves the same scientific content, empirical evidence, proofs, reproducibility details, limitations, and presentation throughout the main text and appendices. Updating the arXiv version/date stamp and its corresponding link produces no meaningful change in paper quality.
